first.rationale: Current metrics show 6% activation decline and 4% onboarding completion decline—both directly addressable by signup/onboarding simplification. Memory 31 and 86 both demonstrated durable improvements to early funnel metrics through field reduction and flow shortening. Memory 91 (activation messaging) provides a secondary lever if onboarding simplification alone proves insufficient. Promotional pricing (memory 73) is ruled out because it materially harmed 30-day retention despite acquisition lift—misaligned with sustainable revenue objective. Referral incentives work in established cohorts but don't address the immediate activation/onboarding collapse. Enterprise sales assist targets a different segment and doesn't solve the SMB activation drag. Simplifying onboarding targets the immediate problem with proven mechanism and no documented retention downside. Verifying memories 31 and 86 will confirm field-count thresholds and completion-lift magnitudes before deploying.
